I should have written this review last spring. But I couldn't. Every time I think about my experience at that clinic, I feel bad. I've never been treated so strangely in healthcare. If I had the energy, I would have gone ahead and reported it, but I'm too sick and have to put my energy where I feel best to have it. But I want to share my experience so that others don't have to go through the same thing!
It should be mentioned that I was in contact with someone at the clinic in Borås and received an apology, but never from the gynecologist who was behind the incident. I recorded the visit, so I'm not imagining it, I'm not exaggerating, everything is there to listen to. My recommendation is that if you have endometriosis - don't come here! That's my experience of having met two gynecologists here. The first one was at least friendly. The second one had left kindness, respect, dignity and empathy somewhere. During the entire visit she used a commanding style, I wasn't allowed to finish a sentence, she interrupted whatever I tried to say, she was really good at steamrolling tactics. The visit ended abruptly with the words "I consider this visit over now", not goodbye, don't you have anything else you want to ask? After 15 minutes of steamrolling tactics it was still quite nice, because as I said I still feel bad today, six months later. Of course, using your superior position to engage in professional abuse of power should not be allowed to occur, but here it is. So my experience of this clinic is that they don't even deserve a star, they get it because the interior was nice.
(I promised the gynecologist not to post the conversation in social contexts so you can believe my experience and know that it is recorded)

one_star_reviews.text:
I was really disappointed with my experience at Urban Turban in Malmö, especially because I had high expectations for the food.

Being from the region where butter chicken originated, I know this dish and its flavours very well. I specifically asked the attendant to request that the chef prepare it in the Indian style, which is marked as an “Urban Turban Special” on the menu.

Unfortunately, what I received was nowhere close to what I expected. It was essentially chicken chunks in a very chilli-heavy sauce. I honestly cannot remember having such a disappointing butter chicken in my life. Butter chicken should be rich, creamy and balanced, with layers of flavour. Authentic Indian food is not simply about making a dish spicy or adding more chilli. It is about the depth and balance of spices and flavours.

I was also expecting someone from the kitchen, ideally the chef, to come and ask for feedback, especially since I had specifically requested the dish to be prepared differently. Unfortunately, that never happened.

If you are looking for authentic Punjabi/Indian food, my advice would be to clearly explain to the chef what you expect before ordering. For me, this particular dish was a major disappointment and unfortunately did not live up to the expectations I had from the restaurant.

Completely unacceptable treatment from OBOS during biennial inspection

I recently had a biennial inspection of my apartment in Brf Rosendals Trädgård in Uppsala. The inspector was very professional, systematically went through the apartment and documented the defects I reported.

The OBOS representative, however, behaved in a way that I experienced as completely unprofessional and disrespectful.

Almost every defect I raised was met with sarcastic comments, questions and strange assumptions about what I had or had not done in the apartment. Instead of first investigating the problems, the starting point time and again seemed to be that they must be due to us who live there.

When I raised the issue of cooking fumes from other apartments coming into the home, he began to speculate, for example, that I was not cleaning the filter in the cooker hood. When I showed a balcony door that was sticking and difficult to close, he claimed that it was due to lack of maintenance, even though the problem was clearly that the door itself was hanging. There were consistently such bizarre assumptions about our cleaning and maintenance routines without him having any basis for them.

It is of course completely okay for a representative of OBOS to make a different technical assessment than I do. What is not okay is to treat a customer in this way in their own home, with a condescending and confrontational attitude and with speculation about how the home is maintained.

The strangest thing was that the independent inspector was simultaneously able to identify and document several of the defects I had reported. If OBOS does not agree with the inspector's assessments, they should reasonably discuss it objectively with him, instead of arguing with the tenant-owner and trying to explain the problems with invented shortcomings in cleaning and maintenance.

I have rarely been treated so badly by a company representative. After this experience, my trust in OBOS has greatly diminished. A company that sells homes for several million should be able to demand basic professional and respectful treatment from its representatives.

I am extremely disappointed with the results of my rhinoplasty.

It has now been six months since my surgery, and I honestly cannot see the improvement I was hoping for.

My main request before the surgery was to make the tip of my nose significantly narrower, slimmer, and more refined. This was the most important thing I wanted to change.

However, six months later, the tip of my nose looks almost exactly the same as it did before the operation. It is still just as wide, rounded, and bulky.

I understand that rhinoplasty requires time to heal and that some swelling may remain. But after six months, I expected to see at least some noticeable improvement in the shape and width of my nasal tip.

I spent a significant amount of money, went through surgery and recovery, and trusted the surgeon to help me achieve the result we discussed.

Instead, I feel deeply disappointed, frustrated, and emotionally exhausted.

I keep asking myself: what exactly did I go through all of this for if the main thing I wanted to change still looks the same?

I sincerely hope there will be further improvement, but at this point, I am extremely unhappy with the result.

Our experience with BOSTHLM Real Estate Agents Nacka was a big disappointment, especially after the assignment was completed.

I would like to share my experience with BOSTHLM, as I believe it may be relevant to others in Tollare who are considering selling their home.

We hired BOSTHLM to sell our apartment. After almost four months, six private viewings and two open viewings without a single bid, we finally decided to end the collaboration.

We fully understand that the housing market can be challenging and that both timing and which speculators appear play a major role. No broker can guarantee a sale. However, we had expected a greater ability to take advantage of the interest from speculators, drive the dialogue forward and convert viewings into concrete bids and closings.

We had also agreed on a generous fee scale to create extra incentives, but unfortunately did not feel that it had any noticeable effect.

In the meantime, we naturally started looking for our next home and found a home we really wanted to buy. Unfortunately, we were unable to act on the opportunity because our own sale did not go ahead. It was of course a great disappointment for us as a family.

But what disappoints us most is how we were treated after the collaboration ended.

When we decided to change brokers, we offered to pay for the existing home photos in order to quickly continue the sale. BOSTHLM refused, citing internal policy.

We understand that companies have their procedures and agreements, but find it difficult to understand why they cannot even find a solution where a previous customer can buy the photos.

The consequence for us is further delays after almost four months without results. We now need to arrange new photography, which makes it difficult to market the apartment in the best way, especially since our home is best during the summer.

As a family with two small children, the whole process has already involved a lot of time, work and adjustments to viewings. To be met with this inflexibility when we try to move forward feels both unnecessary and very disappointing.

We obviously respect that others may have had positive experiences with BOSTHLM. However, our experience is different.

We have also previously left a review about our experience that is no longer visible. We do not know why it disappeared, but we think it is important that negative customer experiences are also allowed to come to light.

It is therefore not only the lack of sales that is behind our criticism. It is primarily the lack of flexibility, willingness to find solutions and customer focus after the assignment has been completed.

Based on our own experience, my advice to other home sellers in Tollare is to choose a different brokerage firm than BOSTHLM.

Unfortunately, we cannot recommend them.
